tldr: A genuinely good inflation print (core PCE 3.0% y/y vs 3.3% expected) got overridden by dollar strength and hawkish rate-path positioning: gold/silver ETFs fell anyway (GLD -0.54%, SLV -1.75%) and 10Y/30Y yields hit fresh cycle highs (5.29%/5.63%) -- Friday's payrolls (consensus ~85-90K vs August's 162K) is now the pivotal near-term catalyst for the whole book.

Don't read the -4.85% Brent print as an oil crash: it traded on only ~53 contracts, a thin-volume roll artifact, while the real signal (USO +1.61%, a genuine Brent-WTI spread blowout to ~$12/bbl on Trump's floated diesel-export restriction) points the other way.

China extended the rare-earth export-control truce to 10 January 2027 via the Trump-Xi summit (not 10 Nov as previously tracked) -- but MP Materials (+4.09%) keeps rallying on its own Pentagon/magnet-campus news regardless, a reminder the ex-China watchlist now has two distinct drivers, not one.

Market breadth kept deteriorating even as the index only eased modestly: only 3 of 11 S&P sectors are still majority-above their 200-day moving average, and the McClellan Oscillator worsened to -43 -- a narrow, weakening market under a calm-looking headline number.

Hong Kong's Southbound Stock Connect goes fully dark for a full week (1-7 Oct, Golden Week) right after a strong +HK$6.86bn net-buy session led by Tencent -- no read on mainland conviction in the 0700/0981/1810 sleeve until 8 October.

regime.label: Cooling core inflation vs. still-hawkish rates into payrolls
regime.oneLiner: A genuine core-PCE disinflation surprise was overridden by dollar strength and a still-hawkish Fed rate path, leaving yields at cycle highs and the tape thin-breadth fragile into Friday's payrolls.

topNews.headline: August core PCE cools to 3.0% y/y (vs 3.3% expected); October rate-hike odds collapse from ~72% to ~35%
topNews.actionable: The drop in October hike odds should ease the real-yields drag on the silver/miner sleeve, but December odds near 80% mean the position isn't out of the woods -- Friday's payrolls is the next binary catalyst.

topNews.headline: Gold and silver's PCE-day rally fizzles as the dollar rips higher despite cooler inflation
topNews.actionable: The silver/miner sleeve is now trading off dollar strength as much as real yields, so Friday's payrolls matters for the dollar leg too, not just the rate-hike-odds leg.

topNews.headline: Brent-WTI spread blows out to widest since May on a Gulf export recovery plus a possible Trump diesel-export ban
topNews.actionable: A US-refining-policy story layered on a genuine Gulf-supply recovery, not a demand shock -- shouldn't be read as a fresh headwind for the inflation-hedge thesis.

topNews.headline: Trump-Xi summit extends the rare-earth export-control truce to January 10, 2027, but MP Materials keeps rallying on Pentagon/magnet-campus news, not the truce
topNews.actionable: Worth distinguishing MP's own defense-demand fundamentals from the broader China-scarcity-premium trade when sizing the ex-China rare-earth watchlist.

topNews.actionable: A second, homegrown risk factor for the 0700/0981/1810 sleeve on top of the US real-yields story, and mainland China's closure through Oct 7 means lower-liquidity, HK-only swings for the rest of the week.
